text:
taylor: Quick internal: Hosted endpoint "orion" is GA. Oriented for mixed workloads (chat + embeddings) with streaming + tool-calling enabled. Docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/hosted/orion-ga

deploy-bot: [deploy] orion canary rolled to us-central-1, health checks green :white_check_mark:

mata: Will default aliases change? any immediate breaks?

taylor: No forced alias flips today. We add "orion-latest" alias and will schedule a monitored flip in 10 days after telemetry review.

ops-oncall: Ops notes: connection default bumped 30->45 per pod for orion. New dashboards: /dashboards/orion-p95 and /dashboards/orion-toolcalls. Paging: sustained p95 token latency > 320ms for 5m triggers page.

billing: Pricing: orion-lite SKU at ~0.65x token cost; orion-pro uses existing hosted-pro units. See price sheet in docs. Committed-plan adjustments will be applied next cycle.

sdk-bot: SDK updates: streaming multiplex helper in node/py v0.20.0. Migration snippets added in PR #721. legacy stream flag deprecated in 40 days.

support: Please prep KB blurb and canned responses for customers.

product-marketing: We'll embargo public marketing until next Tue. Town hall tomorrow 09:00 PT for rollouts and customer comms. Recording + slides to follow.

ops-oncall: Run websocket + tool-call smoke tests in staging and tag @ops-oncall with failures.

taylor: Thanks team  big step forward — coordinate comms with sales/support for customers >10k tokens/day. :rocket:
